segments.text: As soone as Iesus heard that word spoken, he said vnto the Ruler of the Sinagogue, be not afraid, onely beleeue.
So Moses made a serpent of brasse, and set it vp for a signe, and when a serpent had bitten a man, then he looked to the serpent of brasse and liued.
And as Moses lift vp the serpent in the wildernesse, so must the sonne of man bee lifted vp.
That whosoeuer beleeueth in him, should not perish, but haue eternall life.
